gui

Class UtilsJavaFX

  • java.lang.Object
    • gui.UtilsJavaFX

  • final class UtilsJavaFX
extends java.lang.Object
    Provides utility methods for JavaFX user-interface operations used throughout the application.

    This class is package-private and intended solely for internal GUI operations.

      • launchPopup

        static void launchPopup(javafx.stage.Window owner,
                        java.lang.String title,
                        java.lang.String msg,
                        javafx.scene.control.Alert.AlertType type)
        Displays a modal alert dialog to the user, applying the stylesheets from the given owner window to the dialog.
        Parameters:
        owner - the owner Window for the dialog; may be null
        title - the title string for the alert window
        msg - the message content string
        type - the Alert.AlertType defining the severity level

      • launchPopup

        static void launchPopup(javafx.scene.Node targetNode,
                        java.lang.String title,
                        java.lang.String msg,
                        javafx.scene.control.Alert.AlertType type)
        Displays a modal alert dialog to the user, using the specified UI node to determine the owner window and theme stylesheets when available.
        Parameters:
        targetNode - a UI Node whose scene and window are used to style and own the dialog when available
        title - the title string for the alert window
        msg - the message content string
        type - the Alert.AlertType defining the severity level

      • getById

        static <T extends javafx.scene.Node> T getById(javafx.scene.Node root,
                                               java.lang.String id,
                                               java.lang.Class<T> type)
        Retrieves a node by ID, verifies its type, and casts it to the expected type.
        Type Parameters:
        T - the expected node type
        Parameters:
        root - the root node from which to begin the search
        id - the target JavaFX node ID
        type - the expected node type token, for example TextField.class. It must not be null
        Returns:
        the matching node cast to T
        Throws:
        java.util.NoSuchElementException - if no node with the specified ID exists
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if a node with the specified ID exists but is not an instance of type

      • switchTheme

        static void switchTheme(javafx.scene.layout.Pane pane,
                        java.lang.String styleName)
        Switches the active application UI theme by replacing the stylesheets applied to the scene containing the root pane.

        The specified theme is loaded and applied to the application. If themeFileName is null, no change is made. If the specified theme cannot be found, the current theme remains unchanged and an error is reported.

        Parameters:
        pane - the root container or UI element used to retrieve the current scene
        styleName - the file name of the theme to apply (e.g., "dark-theme.css"), or null to leave the current theme unchanged

      • formatFileSize

        static java.lang.String formatFileSize(long bytes)
        Formats a byte count as a human-readable file size using binary units.

        Values are expressed using units of B, KB, MB, GB, or TB, where each unit represents 1024 of the previous unit.

        Parameters:
        bytes - the file size in bytes
        Returns:
        the formatted file size using a single decimal place

      • createIcon

        public static javafx.scene.image.ImageView createIcon(java.lang.String iconName,
                                                      double size,
                                                      boolean isDark)
        Creates a sized ImageView for a UI icon, with optional brightness adjustment for improved contrast in dark themes.
        Parameters:
        iconName - the name of the icon resource within the /gui/icons classpath directory
        size - the target width and height in pixels
        isDark - true to brighten the icon for display against a dark background
        Returns:
        an ImageView displaying the icon, or null if the resource cannot be found
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if size is less than or equal to zero

      • writeToTextFlow

        static void writeToTextFlow(javafx.scene.text.TextFlow targetFlow,
                            java.lang.String message,
                            java.lang.String styleClass)
        Appends a message as a styled Text node to the specified TextFlow. The message is terminated with a newline if it does not already end with one.
        Parameters:
        targetFlow - the TextFlow to which the message is appended
        message - the message text to append
        styleClass - the optional CSS class name to apply, for example "log-success", "log-error", or "log-warn"
